title: VasoMIM: Vascular Anatomy-Aware Masked Image Modeling for Vessel Segmentation
mechanism: MIM where an unsupervised Frangi map steers masking onto thin-structure patches (ramp 0 to 0.5, ratio 0.5) and a frozen small segmentor enforces that the reconstruction keeps the same vessels.
adaptation: Dark-ridge filter (Frangi on inverted EL, sigma 1-2 px, or black top-hat) for crack-guided masking; consistency through the frozen house U-Net++ crack / inactive logits instead of their UNeXt; on top of the Frepa or FCMAE ConvNeXt arm.
min_experiment: Arm: best ConvNeXt MIM arm + crack-guided masking + house-model consistency. Baseline: same arm with random masking. Kill if out-of-fold crack relF1@2 < +0.005 and E1 crack recall < +0.01.
evidence: R: 20,650 unlabelled angiograms, ViT-B/16 + U-Net; MAE vs scratch +18.5 Dice at 25% labels; VasoMIM over MAE only +0.35 to +1.1 Dice.
prior_overlap: None for structure-guided masking; plain MIM on R34 closed.

alt_notes.adaptation: Ridge-filter-guided masking at ratio 0.5 and consistency through frozen house crack/inactive logits, added on top of the best FCMAE/Frepa arm.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Winner of FCMAE/Frepa + guided masking vs the same without; kill if out-of-fold relF1@2 < +0.005 and E1 recall < +0.01.
